note: Local pack gates prepare evidence for human review. Not CE / not notified-body. Not a conformity assessment.

questions.human_question: For human review: SECURITY.md present with Security header and substantive content.
questions.remediation_hint: Add SECURITY.md with vulnerability reporting and response expectations.

questions.human_question: For human review: security.txt present for coordinated disclosure.
questions.remediation_hint: Create .well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires fields.

questions.human_question: For human review: No banned axios versions in dependencies or devDependencies.
questions.remediation_hint: Upgrade axios to a patched release and refresh the lockfile.

questions.human_question: For human review: No secret-like patterns in house policy document paths or common agent secret files.
questions.remediation_hint: Remove credentials from docs and agent-oops paths; rotate any exposed secrets; use a secret manager.

questions.human_question: For human review: No placeholder patterns in required security docs.
questions.remediation_hint: Replace TODO / lorem ipsum / [insert ...] with real contact and process details.
